title: More Curses
description: New curses that introduce fun gameplay twists instead of being a simple detriment.
body:
A mod about curses.
## New Curses
- Curse of the Undead: Grants Undead traits such as sunburn, water breathing, inverted heal and harm potion effects, etc.
- Curse of Explosiveness: Makes the cursed item explode when it breaks.
- Curse of Obliteration: When it breaks, the cursed weapon can instantly kill the wielder or the attacked entity with a 90% and 10% chance respectively.
- Curse of Ender: Grants some Enderman traits such as water damage and projectile immunity.
- Curse of the Mets: Halves damage of the weapon and increases knockback dramatically.
- Curse of Resizing: Increases/Decreases body size and attack damage based on current health.
- Curse of Insomnia: Prevents sleeping. Increases Attack Damage for each night survived up to 10 times. Decreases Max Health every 2 nights up to 5 times.

## Misc.
I recommend installing [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions) and [TooltipFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltipfix).

The mod also adds a chance of getting curses on the Enchanting Table.
